sourceText:
Fava Beans And Rice-فول اخضر بالرز
By: Mimi Cooks
Published: Sunday, March 28, 2010 - 11:39am

Ingredients




1/2 kilo frozen or fresh fava beans also known as Broad Beans
1 onion
cooking oil
1 cup rice
salt, black pepper, all spice,
1 cup of water

Preparation

1 Wash the rice and soak for 10 minutes 2 Dice the onion into small pieces 3 In a pot, add cooking oil and saute the onion until translucent 4 Add the fava beans, and stir around in the pot to coat with the oil 5 Drain the rice and add to the pot with the onions and fava beans 6 Mix well. 7 Add the seasoning and spices 8 Mix well and then add the water 9 Cover the pot. On high heat cook the mix until the water boils,then lower the heat and simmer on low heat until the rice is fully cooked and fluffy. 10 Serve hot with yogurt or green salad on the side

About


Fava beans are also known as Broad beans.

Comments:
YEZEN

Should be peeling fava beans
YEZEN

Excellent and delicious .. Preferable to add dill
Mimi Cooks

Yezen, thanks for the tip of using dill...great idea, i should try it next time.
Mimi Cooks

Yezen, i appreciate your input but i have to disagree with you about peeling the fava beans...If they are fresh and in season then the peel is very soft and almost transparent you do not need to get rid of them, but if the fava beans are not in season and they have tough peel i think you should peel them. after all the peel adds to its nutritional value, its all good fiber!
